paper.title: Tree Search-Based Evolutionary Bandits for Protein Sequence Optimization

settings.name_in_paper: Bayesian sequence design with GP fitness prior over embedded sequences within a Hamming ball (tree search)
unmapped: Actions are discrete amino-acid sequences within Hamming distance N of a wild-type, mapped to R^d by a known Lipschitz embedding phi; the learner can only move locally (tree search), with Condition 3.2 requiring each step to reach at least the local maximum of the sampled function within radius r of the previous iterate in embedding space
settings.definition_quote: we focus on a local searching region $\bar{\mathcal{X}} := \{x: d(x, x^{wt}) \leq N\} ... $f^{\star}:\mathbb{R}^d \to R$ is a sample from the Gaussian process $\mathcal{GP}(0, k(\cdot, \cdot))$ (with known kernel function) ... $\tilde F(x) = f^{\star}(\phi(x)) + \epsilon$, where $\epsilon \sim \mathcal{N}(0, \lambda), \lambda > 1$

algorithms.name: Meta algorithm (tree search with rarely-switching GP posterior sampling, Alg. 1 / Alg. 3)

bound.expression_latex: \beta_{T}\sqrt{\lambda T \gamma_{T}} + B \gamma_{T} \rbra{1 + \frac{4 L_{\phi}^2 N^2}{r^2}},\ \beta_T = O( \mathbb{E}[\|f^{\star}\|_{k}]+\sqrt{d \ln T} + \sqrt{\gamma_{T-1}})

symbols.f_norm: E[||f*||_k], expected RKHS norm of the GP sample
symbols.gamma_Tm1: maximum information gain over T-1 rounds
symbols.B_f: bound on |f_t| over the local region D
symbols.L_phi: Lipschitz constant of the embedding map phi
symbols.N_depth: tree-search depth (max Hamming distance from wild-type)

conditions: Assumption 3.6: each f_t bounded by B on D, locally concave, L_f-Lipschitz, attains maximum in the interior of D
Condition 3.2: each tree-search step finds x_t with F_t(x_t) >= max F_t over ||phi(x)-phi(x_{t-1})|| <= r
embedding phi is L_phi-Lipschitz w.r.t. Hamming distance
tuning: f_t resampled from the GP posterior only when det(V_t)/det(V_pre(t)) > 2 (O(gamma_T) updates)

source.label: thm:main
source.quote: Under Assumption \ref{asmp:gp_f}, \ref{asmp:noisy_fdb}, \ref{asmp:ft_cvx} and Condition \ref{cond:local_argmax}, Alg.\ref{alg:meta} updates $f_t$ for $O \rbra{\gamma_T}$ times its Bayesian regret is bounded by \operatorname{BayesRGT}(T) = O \rbra{  \beta_{T}\sqrt{\lambda T \gamma_{T}} + B \gamma_{T} \rbra{1 + \frac{4 L_{\phi}^2 N^2}{r^2}}}, where $\beta_T = O\left( \mathbb{E} \sbra{\|f^{\star}\|_{k}}+\sqrt{d \ln T} + \sqrt{\gamma_{T-1}}\right)$.

results.notes: beta_T substituted into the expression. Regret is against the best sequence in the Hamming ball. The proof sets lambda = 1+1/T even though Assumption 3.5 only requires lambda > 1. The paper notes this gives Õ(d sqrt T) for a linear kernel.
